Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. #27895's order said: "if all types do not fit one PR, list the rest with a ready-to-file title". PR #27931's report (6514901941, `out_of_scope_findings`) left `chart` out by name.
Reach: Studio › Interfaces › list-view panel of a chart view, after "Add view" (PR #27870) makes one.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (Studio).
Duplicate search: dedupe words below; #27895 and #27896 are the sibling cards (other types' settings, view switcher), not this.

## Observed
Since #27895 the list-view panel edits every non-grid type's block except `chart`. `ListChartConfigSchema` is `{ chartType, dataset, values, dimensions }`, an ADR-0021 dataset plus measure and dimension names. The generic form would draw `dataset` and `values` as free text, so the section leaves chart out.

## Wanted
A chart section that reuses the Create View dialog's `useDatasetCatalog` (datasets whose base object is this object) and `useDatasetSemantics` (that dataset's measures and dimensions), picking each by label and writing `config.chart`. Landing: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`.

Dedupe words: studio list view chart dataset measure binding inspector.

Related: #27895, PR #27931, #27836.
